description:
## What

New workspace crate `pkix-dane`. no_std-friendly. Provides:

- TLSA record types: usage (CertUsage), selector (Selector), matching type (MatchingType), association data
- DER / wire-format parsing for TLSA records
- Per-usage match logic per RFC 6698 §2.1 + RFC 7218 disambiguation:
  - usage 0 (PKIX-TA): constrain which CA must sign
  - usage 1 (PKIX-EE): constrain leaf cert
  - usage 2 (DANE-TA): synthesize trust anchor from TLSA-asserted cert/SPKI
  - usage 3 (DANE-EE): direct match on leaf cert, bypassing chain
- Per-usage verify functions:
  - `verify_pkix_ta(path: &ValidatedPath, tlsa: &[TlsaRecord]) -> Result<(), DaneError>`
  - `verify_pkix_ee(leaf: &Certificate, tlsa: &[TlsaRecord]) -> Result<(), DaneError>`
  - `verify_dane_ta(leaf: &Certificate, tlsa: &[TlsaRecord]) -> Result<TrustAnchor, DaneError>`
  - `verify_dane_ee(leaf: &Certificate, tlsa: &[TlsaRecord]) -> Result<(), DaneError>`
- DaneError enum — Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq + non_exhaustive, Send + Sync (per AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6)
- No DNS. Caller supplies validated TLSA records (DNSSEC verified externally).

## RFCs in scope

- RFC 6698 — The DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol: TLSA
- RFC 7218 — Adding Acronyms to Simplify Conversations About DANE  
- RFC 7671 — The DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) Protocol: Updates and Operational Guidance
- RFC 7929 — DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) Bindings for OpenPGP (probably out of scope but cross-reference)
- RFC 8460 — SMTP TLS Reporting (related; out of scope here)

## Out of scope

- DNS resolution (in pkix-dane-resolver)
- SMTP-specific DANE policy (RFC 7672 — possibly a separate verify_smtp_dane helper later)
- Integration into pkix-chain (separate child)

## Acceptance

- [ ] no_std builds clean
- [ ] DaneError satisfies non-negotiable #6
- [ ] Four per-usage verify functions implemented
- [ ] Test fixtures: TLSA records + corresponding cert chains covering all four usages
- [ ] Differential oracle: at minimum, OpenSSL's danessl or sufficient public test vectors

## Stub status

Future work. Filed as architectural commitment under PKIX-j32w.
